authority.description: authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless overwritten).

cosmos.upgrade.v1beta1.MsgSoftwareUpgrad.title: Msg Software Upgrade
cosmos.upgrade.v1beta1.MsgSoftwareUpgrad.description: MsgSoftwareUpgrade is the Msg/SoftwareUpgrade request type.

name.description: Sets the name for the upgrade. This name will be used by the upgraded version of the software to apply any special "on-upgrade" commands during the first BeginBlock method after the upgrade is applied. It is also used to detect whether a software version can handle a given upgrade. If no upgrade handler with this name has been set in the software, it will be assumed that the software is out-of-date when the upgrade Time or Height is reached and the software will exit.

time.description: Deprecated: Time based upgrades have been deprecated. Time based upgrade logic has been removed from the SDK. If this field is not empty, an error will be thrown.

height.description: The height at which the upgrade must be performed.

info.description: Any application specific upgrade info to be included on-chain such as a git commit that validators could automatically upgrade to

type_url.description: The type url prefixed with a slash, like '/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend'

value.description: Must be a valid serialized protocol buffer of the above specified type.

upgraded_client_state.description: Deprecated: UpgradedClientState field has been deprecated. IBC upgrade logic has been moved to the IBC module in the sub module 02-client. If this field is not empty, an error will be thrown.

cosmos.upgrade.v1beta1.Plan.title: Plan
cosmos.upgrade.v1beta1.Plan.description: Plan specifies information about a planned upgrade and when it should occur.

cosmos.upgrade.v1beta1.MsgSoftwareUpgrad.title: Msg Software Upgrade Response
cosmos.upgrade.v1beta1.MsgSoftwareUpgrad.description: MsgSoftwareUpgradeResponse is the Msg/SoftwareUpgrade response type.
